title: Mixed Event — What lies behind. What lies ahead. — Episode4 Slightly Off

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.
meta.Event Outline: With the song that made Mafuyu smile complete, positive responses from fans come flooding in. Meanwhile, Mizuki feels like the only one unable to get closer to the other members. One day, the group bumps into An, who has seen a side to Mizuki that the others haven't...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks for waiting, K.
Sorry for being late!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You're fine.
Yuki and I just got here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. I'm fine now!
I think that all-nighter took more out of me than I realized.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But I'm glad you're okay.
Anyway, shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The demo's going to take a little more time, but I'd like to hear what Yuki has to say about it before doing anything more to it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And Enanan, Amia, I'd also like to ask you both for any suggestions regarding motifs or other ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You got it!
Let's give it our best shot♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, that's about it for me. Things are going pretty smoothly this time around, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, they are!
I'd really rather not have to pull another all-nighter.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, this has nothing to do with what we're talking about, but this new shop opened up in front of the station. Wanna go check it out?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! You can play all sorts of VR games there! How does next Sunday sound...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My club is having a practice match that day so I'll be busy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, I won't put you through that... But you're free, right, Enanan?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I'm busy too, you know? I promised my mom that I'd go out with her that day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No! That's strike three!
Dang... I really wanted to go too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, okay. We can go some other time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, when's the last time Mizuki invited us out somewhere like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not since we went on that mystery tour as far as I know.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Does this mean Mizuki's figured something out about that other thing...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo for our new song's finished and was hoping that you'd listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, sure.
I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. And please don't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪ I can't wait for our next song! I'm really looking forward to reading the lyrics too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, don't be like that!
Enaemon, Mafuyu's so cold...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know perfectly well that you won't get much of a reaction from Mafuyu. Also, who's “Enaemon”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not in the slightest, so quit calling me that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! Your songs have always been amazing, Kanade, you've been on fire with your last few!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I guess that's just the great Kanade Yoisaki for you! Alright, I'm gonna give the video everything I've got!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In your usual spot, I see?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No. You seemed to have something on your mind, so I was just wondering what exactly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It has nothing to do with you.
Why don't you go back now, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was like you were staring at someone the entire time... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something going on with Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Took you long enough.
We were thinking about heading back since we're done listening to the demo, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure you're okay? You weren't really all there just now, so maybe a screw came loose or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! I was joking♪
Anyway, let's head back and get to work!
